svg.title: Iterated state update (schematic)
svg.desc: A cycle: IMU propagation gives the predicted state and covariance; LiDAR points are transformed with the current estimate; map correspondences give residuals; residuals are linearised; the iterated Kalman correction updates the estimate; the loop repeats until converged, then the scan is inserted into the map.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: prior uncertainty + LiDAR geometric residuals → corrected state
